name: WABOT-1
summary: Built by Ichiro Kato's group at Waseda University, WABOT-1 is generally regarded as the world's first full-scale anthropomorphic intelligent robot. It combined a limb-control system that walked quasi-statically and gripped objects with tactile hands, a vision system that measured distances and bearings to objects, and a conversation system that understood and replied in spoken Japanese.
notable: Integrated walking, vision, tactile grasping and speech in one machine
